dateNote: The requested evidence directory is dated 29 October; actual UTC timestamps identify execution time.
sequence: manual save under unique disposable name
native load command unloads and reloads manual save
errorRule: After-only StreetLamp ChangeLightSetting NullReferenceException or FoodTrucks detached-save ERROR across two runs per build means FAIL and no further tests. Both-build or neither-build reproduction passes the specified attribution gate.
financialRule: Before/after equality; the known native-versus-resident conservation discrepancy is reported separately.
noiseRule: For each p50/p95/max metric in mod union work and whole-frame, compare median difference with the larger full within-build range. Report ranges, per-window values and limitations; no causal or statistical-equivalence claim.
autosave: Record original native flag/preferences; off before and after every window and after reload. Reject changed save file sizes/mtimes or actual save log markers. Manual saves outside windows.
cleanup: Full agent1 profile inventory/SHA256, root receipt/run/log and preferences backup/restore; stop; verify lease release.
boundaries: no ordinary profile, saves or ModsLocal
